extracted.name: Griddled pears with goat's cheese & hazelnut dressing
extracted.description: Impress guests with this deceptively simple starter, made with pears, goat's cheese, watercress and hazelnuts. It's ready in just 15 minutes, and perfect at Christmas
ingredient_lines: 40g toasted hazelnuts finely chopped or crushed
1 tbsp balsamic or red wine vinegar
instruction_lines: Combine the hazelnuts with the oil, vinegar and a pinch of sea salt flakes. Slice each pear into six wedges.

Heat a griddle pan over a high heat and griddle the pear wedges until slightly charred. Arrange three in a line on each plate. Tuck some watercress around the pears, then crumble over the goat’s cheese. Dot over the hazelnut dressing.
